sample_unit: patients (831 reports) in test set; 68 cases in reader study

links.outcome: Radiologist efficiency and performance with versus without LLM assistance
links.effect: Four radiologists assessed 68 cases with and without LLM assistance; significant time-efficiency improvements across all radiologists with LLM assistance (p < 0.001); diagnostic consistency may improve, especially for junior clinicians.
links.quote: Significant improvements in time efficiency were observed across all radiologists with LLM assistance (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Accuracy comparison of two LLMs against radiologist reference standard for NPC staging
links.effect: DeepSeek-V3-0324 outperformed GPT-4o-latest in TRE-1 (96.5% vs. 82.9%, p < 0.001); no significant difference for T staging, N staging, or TRE-2.
links.quote: DeepSeek-V3-0324 significantly outperformed GPT-4o-latest in TRE-1 staging (96.5% vs. 82.9%, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM performance on cancer staging and treatment response evaluation and includes a reader study comparing radiologists' performance and efficiency with versus without LLM assistance.
